description: We are tech enthusiasts using AI, data science, and software engineering to tackle environmental challenges. For Space Apps 2026, we're building FireBlindspot—a platform harmonizing NASA's MODIS and VIIRS satellite data to resolve wildfire detection gaps, uncover historical burn patterns, and deliver clear geospatial insights. We welcome curious, motivated teammates in AI/ML, Python, GIS, full-stack dev, UI/UX, and research. Let's build something impactful together!
